description: ae-motion: ask the user before a shell command downloads files (music, SFX, video). Set AE_MOTION_ALLOW_DOWNLOADS=1 to turn it off.

hooks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/confirm_download.py"; command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/confirm_download.py"; exit 0
